title: The first maple bar
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Gully brings maple bars from the bakery, day-old, in a paper sack. He gives Wood one. The strip has drawn food before; it hasn't drawn Gully paying for it.

panels.composition: The dock. GULLY with a paper sack, day-old, the bakery's name on it as blocks. WOOD on a crab pot.

image.prompt: a stocky teenager holding a paper bakery sack on a dock while a young man sits on an upturned crab pot, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The sack open: maple bars, four, the glaze cracked.

image.prompt: close on a paper sack open to show four maple bars with cracked glaze, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Gully handing one over. Wood taking it. Neither looking at the other.

image.prompt: a teenager handing a maple bar to a young man on a dock, both looking at the water, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The two of them on the dock eating. The uncle's skiff. The bay. Four panels, and in the last one the sack folded small in Gully's pocket for next time.

image.prompt: two young men eating pastries side by side on a dock above gray water, a skiff tied below, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: Gully's currency, first shown. The sack folded for next time.
